description_expanded: ABOUT STELLA BY THE SEA: A beachside villa built exclusively for travelers seeking luxury accommodations and beachside relaxation. "Stella by the Sea" is a new vacation rental located in the private coastal community of Carillon Beach and sits just a few steps from the Emerald Coastline. The coastal breeze surrounds the entire wrap around porch, inspiring that "off-the-grid" feeling while quaint white picket fences and paved bicycle paths line the street. Well-appointed walkout balconies overlook everything from the sparkling emerald water to the beautiful coastal architecture of the neighborhood. Stella by the Sea is fully equipped to offer each of its guests a multitude of vacation experiences, without even leaving the house! Indoor/outdoor cooking, dining, lounging, sun-bathing, napping…. The list goes on and on. For those seeking a lifetime of travel memories, look no further and book today. The heart of Stella by the Sea is on the ground floor with its immaculate open living space and wall-to-wall windows which allow the Florida sun to pour in from all angles. State-of-the-art architecture and interior design have merged to create a unique kitchen and dining space offering a massive 22 ft. single countertop that spans more than half of the kitchen, living, and dining area. A full wet bar, beverage cooler, multiple sinks, food prep area, and appliances (both small and large) line from one side to the other offering endless options to eat, drink and have fun together! The fully equipped kitchen has everything needed to cook, host, and serve meals for any-size occasion. There are two indoor living spaces - each with multiple sofas (including 1 pullout sleeper) and dining tables, seating up to 12 guests in total. On the 2nd floor is where you'll find the first set of bedroom accommodation. On the East side is a well-appointed balcony suite which includes a king-sized bed and hideaway loft-style area with a built-in ladder. Each of these areas have a birds-eye view of the large walkout balcony overlooking the neighborhood and beach access at the end of the street. The comfortable bed swing and bistro set are perfect additions to enjoying that first cup of coffee in the morning as well as the last glass of red, before bedtime. Across from the hall is the second balcony suite with king bed, luxurious ensuite and furnished balcony. This outdoor space wraps around the entire South/Southeast side of the home and is equipped with a bed swing, rocking chairs, and bistro set. The 3rd floor room is at the very peak and offers 360° views of the entire neighborhood with the waves of the Emerald Coast peeking through! Wrap around windows on all sides gives this king room a true beach vacation vibe. ABOUT THE AREA: Carillon Beach Resort on the Emerald Coast is the perfect destination for a relaxing and adventurous getaway. Start your stay with a stroll down Carillon Market Street, where you can explore charming shops, savor local cuisine at various eateries, and admire art in galleries. The resort also offers a pristine one-mile stretch of private beach with seven exclusive access points, providing a serene and uncrowded beach experience. For those seeking outdoor activities, the resort has something for everyone. Enjoy walks through scenic parks, swim in one of the resort's pools, play tennis, or engage in more adventurous pursuits like kayaking, snorkeling, and fishing. Guests can also rent bikes, stand-up paddleboards, or kayaks to explore the beautiful surroundings. Wellness is a priority at Carillon Beach Resort, with offerings like rejuvenating yoga classes at Yoga Elements and luxurious tropical treatments at Salon Baliage & Spa. Dining options at the resort cater to all tastes, from casual meals at Our Little Beach Cafe to gourmet experiences at Gratify. The Shipwreck General Store provides a convenient spot for shopping, whether you're looking for essentials or unique souvenirs. Families will find plenty to keep the kids entertained, including basketball and tennis courts, a playground, and easy beach access. Additionally, the resort offers a gym with flexible rates For a spiritual touch, the on-site chapel offers Sunday services, adding to the resort's tranquil atmosphere. Whether you're here for the beach, the activities, or simply to unwind, Carillon Beach Resort delivers a perfect blend of relaxation, recreation, and luxury. This is the ultimate destination for those looking to experience the best of the Emerald Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Private beach access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Complimentary 4 Beach Chairs & 2 Umbrellas. This is seasonal from March 1-October31. * Private gated community * 2 minute walk to the beach * 3 community pools * Carillon Beach Resort has basketball and tennis courts, as well as a playground. PARKING: * Paid Parking available for up to 3 registered vehicles ($35/vehicle) PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * No pets Allowed * There is no smoking inside or outside while on the property. * All reservations are non-refundable, we strongly encourage adding travel insurance to your reservation so that you are covered. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.
